description.value:
The Scout is a Tech half-caster equally at home tracking prey across a wilderness moon or a target across a starport, marrying frontier survival skill with a light but versatile application of Tech powers. A baseline Hunter's Mark-style technique lets a Scout single out a target and bring focused, sustained pressure to bear on it turn after turn.

Scouts round out their kit with personal Scout Routines — practiced sequences of reconnaissance, tracking, and battlefield preparation — that let them operate for extended periods far from support, making them the go-to choice for exploration, bounty work, and irregular warfare alike.
